text: `advanced_measurement_approach_ama` (Advanced Measurement Approach, AMA) calculates an operational risk capital charge using a loss distribution approach. From your historical `annual_event_counts` and `loss_amounts`, it fits a Poisson frequency model and a lognormal severity model, then runs a Monte Carlo simulation to get the operational value-at-risk (OpVaR) at your chosen `confidence_level`. If `expected_loss_covered` is true, capital is OpVaR minus expected loss, floored at zero; otherwise it is the full OpVaR. Under Basel III/IV the Standardised Measurement Approach replaces AMA for regulatory capital (see `basel_standardised_measurement_sma`), so use this mainly for economic capital and internal scenario analysis.
